packages.name: Chatterbox TTS
packages.summary: Resemble AI Chatterbox text to speech, with voice cloning from reference clips.

packages.name: ComfyUI
packages.summary: Node-based image and video generation. The router reads its /object_info and /models probes to learn which loaders and files it has.

packages.name: ComfyUI (python slim image, persistent data folder)
packages.summary: ComfyUI as a hand-built install that lives in a data folder: the stock python:3.12-slim image runs a start script that keeps ComfyUI, its custom nodes and a venv under /data, so an existing install is reused as it is (nothing is reinstalled when it is already there).

packages.name: Kokoro TTS
packages.summary: Kokoro-82M text to speech over the OpenAI speech API (POST /v1/audio/speech).

packages.name: llama.cpp (release build)
packages.summary: llama-server from the official llama.cpp release builds: GGUF models over the OpenAI chat API.

packages.name: Stable Audio 3 (CPU service)
packages.summary: Stable Audio 3 medium (LiteRT/TFLite) music generation on the CPU: POST /generate, GET /health.

packages.name: Whisper (Wyoming faster-whisper)
packages.summary: Speech to text with faster-whisper behind the Wyoming protocol (Home Assistant's voice pipeline).
